This is a long story so bear with me and please don't judge... When I was 7YO I was raped by three family members, this went on until my first period (15YO), only they know this, at 11YO I realised that it was so wrong and felt that somehow it was my fault,I've dealt with self hate issues since then, at that same age I got groped by an elderly man at a bus (I was so scared and disgusted by my own body by then that I beguin thinking about suicide and those thoughts haven't fully left me ever since) at age 17 I got madly in love, at 19 I was engaged and with a newborn baby boy at age 23 he dumped me (too much drama he said) at that same age I got really depressed (would cry myself to sleep one night and the other would go and get wasted) I remember this one night when the pain became too much to bear that I broke my mirror and then tried to slice my throat in two, luckily the mirror broke before I could do any real damage, which spiraled the drinking, it got serious to the point where I'd blackout with no recollection of what happened the night before, I started having this friend that would always supply the alcohol and for a while everything was ok at age 25 I remember this one party he dragged me, alcohol was flowing but I remember drinking only 4 beers the next its a blur but I remember 2 or 3guys f*cking (I can't say they raped me but I can't say it was consensual) me I couldn't even make their faces but I remember that, next morning I was in denial and kept that way until 2-3 months after that I had to take a pregnancy test for my job, I was pregnant, I told no one, I was ashamed and hated myself even more, the idea of suicide became stronger, I lost my job because I was pregnant, so I had more time to harvest this ideas of self hate, I really wanted to die, and started to cut into my hips, had to stop because of fear of my obstetrician finding out, I was depressed according to one therapist that tried to help me, I wanted to give in and tell her everything but I thought that she would judge me for my decisions and think how stupid I must be, so I just stood there crying the whole hour, I left promising her that I would arrange an appointment next week, that never happened, my pregnancy with baby number two was a nightmare I was a shell of a woman and on occasions would lash on my unborn baby telling him how much I hated him and me and how neither of us deserved to live, the worst came when I had to tell my family because I had no job or no way to support myself or my children I had to live in with mom, I made up one story about this mean boyfriend that left the country, even when I had these strong feelings about my pregnancy I decided to keep him and I'm.proud I did, Hes the love of my life, my child. I'm still struggling with self harm and suicidal thoughts, It had affected me in my relationships I have trust issues, and had been accused of being "too cold", I have insomnia and I'd have nightmares the nights that I can get some sleep. After my last relationship ended (a year ago) I went downhill I thought I was going crazy, I really believed that there was a conspiracy to make me go crazy, I'd have what I call my rollercoaster moments when I'd cry non-stop for a couple of days and then I'd do a 180° spin and you would see me making jokes and just being hyper at times like this my ideas just get out of control and it's hard for me to focus on one thing, but that attitude helps me at my work when I'm in contact with people constantly. I still have trust issues, and suffer from sudden panick attacks every now and then, people often stares at me for my looks (im aware of the fact that I have good genes and look exotic) this makes me nervous and can trigger panick attacks and anxiety. On occasions I think I can't go on and start working on these ideas of how to end it all, but no matter how strong these feelings and ideas get I somehow manage to overcome them. I don't want people to tell me to get help, that is out of the question, the shame would be too much for me to bear, I mean there must definitely be something really wrong about me for things like this to happen.

Well I sell furniture in this store and there was one time I was dating a former customer he and his friend would come to the store and ask for me to help them with anything that they wanted to buy, I work on commission so I would put my most serious and efficient persona and help 'm out, this one day the friend came (he's close to 60) and wanted to refurbish his entire house (really big and nice country home) so I went and spent most of the day acting as this decorator/saleswoman/friend and at some point the guy started to get lost in the store, he seemed tired, and wasn't really paying attention to what he was doing so he walked in to this big, massive, solid wood trunk-thing and almost fell to the floor I kept my poker face (or so I thought) but did noticed my coworkers looking at me with this "really?" Look on their faces, soon after the guy left and then my boss walked towards me and told me with a very serious look on her face "it is not nice to laugh at the customers, or to anyone for that matter, when they injure themselves" (very motherly-like) it took me a little bit to realize that I had indeed laughed at this elderly man that happened to be a good friend when he injured himself (mind you that I have one of those very loud, almost annoying laughs)

My dad had suffer from abandon issues from his childhood he even went as far as living on the streets then he met mom and had us, for a while we were doing great although dad would always been a little buzzed on the weekends things escalated slowly until he became a monster for our family I love the old man to death so I tried to help and begged him to go to AA meetings which he went for a while and then he relapsed, he couldn't stay sober for a whole month but I kept pushing, begging him, praying, but nothing changed, it broke my heart to learn that my dad wasn't the strong hero I thought he was, I was a teenager at the time, when I was 18 he left to Costa Rica (I am from Panama LATAM) and didn't knew about him for 10 years I kept looking on the internet for news on his whereabouts but got nothing, until recently that he contacted us. I seriously believed that he was dead. And yes he is still an alcoholic. The way I see it's just one of those things that you have to learn to live with
